strings: r_c0 reassures m_c's Clanmates that m_c is only going to be quiet for a while now. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} just need some time.

m_c only wants to talk to the Clanmates closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. And for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} other Clanmates, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/rely/relies} on sign language and tail signals to communicate.
m_c has gone quiet for a bit, too overwhelmed to speak.
